Subject: NyxLabs onboarding: PO issuance, spend caps & itemization questions

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to get momentum on the onboarding. Two quick items we need to close before our first invoice:

1) PO issuance: Our procurement team needs a formal PO number tied to the onboarding SOW. Can you confirm the PO number and the canonical billing email to use?

2) Line-item mapping: The SOW line descriptions don’t line up exactly with the SKU codes our AP team expects. Attached is our preliminary mapping and a sample invoice for line-level examples. There are three lines where quantities and descriptions diverge — we’d like those normalized before we submit the first bill.

3) Monthly spend cap: Per the SOW we have a soft monthly spend cap; please confirm how that will appear on Redwood’s PO and whether it will be enforced by token quota or flagged for approval.

Attaching: NyxVendor_Onboard_Form.pdf (filled), sample_invoice_Nyx.pdf, Nyx_PO_Mapping_v1.xlsx [attachment].

Could we get a PO issued by end of week? Our pay runs next Tuesday and we’d rather not miss the first cycle.

Cheers,
Meera Shah
Head of Procurement
NyxLabs
meera@nyxlabs.com

Hi Meera — thanks for the form and the mapping sheet. Happy to get this moving. A couple quick clarifications so we issue the PO with correct lines: 

- On your spreadsheet: Line B ("Data Ingest") looks split across two SKUs in your system. Do you want one consolidated line on our side, or two lines that match your AP?
- The monthly spend cap you mentioned — is that a hard cap per month or an annualized budget that you want billed until the cap is reached?

Plan: I’ll loop finance to create a provisional PO and route it to you for acceptance. Priyom (cc) will own the PO number issuance and Ben on ops will attach the formal PO PDF.

If you can confirm the two bullets above, we’ll aim to issue PO within 48 hours.

Ben — forwarding Nyx’s mapping and Camila’s note. I’ve sketched a proposed PO mapping in the attached spreadsheet (Nyx_PO_Mapping_v1.xlsx) with our recommended line codes and provisional monthly caps. Highlights: 

- Proposed PO number: reserve PO-2026-0347 (provisional until Ben confirms).
- Map Data Ingest -> Line 1001 (consolidate their split SKUs into single Data Ingest line to simplify billing).
- Line 1003 (real-time inference) needs quantity correction: vendor listed 10k tokens/month, contract says 100k. I flagged a discrepancy in the sheet.

Meera / Nyx team — thanks for the patience. Per Priyom’s mapping and Camila’s confirmation, we’ve issued the PO. Details below and attached: 

PO number: PO-2026-0347
Billing contact: ap-invoices@redwood.com (please route final PDFs here)
Monthly soft cap: $12,500 (system flags invoices above this amount for manager approval, does not auto-reject — per customer request)
Line items (high level):
 - Line 1001: Data Ingest — consolidated (matches your combined SKU request) — $3,500/month
 - Line 1002: Storage & Retention — $1,250/month
 - Line 1003: Real-time Inference — provisional quantity set to 100,000 tokens/month — flagged for confirmation. If final invoice exceeds this baseline by >25% we will route to Camila for approval.

Action items for Nyx:
1) Confirm you accept consolidation of your Data Ingest SKUs into a single line (Line 1001).
2) Confirm final token quantity for Line 1003 (if 10k was accurate, we will adjust and reissue).

I’ve attached the formal PO PDF (PO-2026-0347.pdf). Priyom — we put a soft hold on Line 1003 until we hear back from Nyx so early invoices may show "pending adjustment" for that line.

Ben Carter
